newsitem.title: UK: IPE gas oil called unchanged to $1 up, Brent firmer.
newsitem.headline: IPE gas oil called unchanged to $1 up, Brent firmer.

text.p: IPE gas oil futures were called to open unchanged to $1.00 a tonne higher on Friday in line with gains made by NYMEX heating oil on ACCESS, brokers said.
May gas oil closed 50 cents down at $162.25 a tonne on Thursday.
June Brent futures were expected to open 10 to 15 cents higher from Thursday's settlement of $17.69 a barrel.
The contract traded on Singapore's SIMEX 12 cents firmer at $17.81 a barrel.
Forecasts of cool temperatures in the U.S. Northeast and the Midwest drove NYMEX heating oil higher on Thursday, and the May contract climbed 0.20 cents a gallon to 54.20 cents.
Private forecaster Weather Services Corp (WSC) said on Friday that cold weather will drive heating oil demand to well above normal over the next 48 hours.
Brent futures eased off highs to close 12 cents lower in a burst of liquidation shortly before the close.
"Gas oil is due $1 up against the arb and unchanged against the Brent," a broker said.
